notes: Seed entries only (Phase 1). Each entry lists its sources and confidence; manufacturer cover programmes are recorded but give no score credit until maintenance evidence is parsed (Phase 3). 'weak_regex' only counts when the engine displacement (cc) is known and listed. A power figure is ended by (?!\d), never \b: trims read '130CH', where \b finds no boundary between '0' and 'C' (kb-2026.11). 'check_fr' is the buyer action the site shows with the risk.
